mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS poolId, p.name AS poolName, p.strategy AS strategy, m.datasource_id AS datasourceId, ds.name AS datasourceName, m.enabled, m.weight, m.max_concurrency AS maxConcurrency, m.sort_no AS sortNo, COALESCE(r.running_count, 0) AS runningCount FROM sys_datasource_pool p INNER JOIN sys_datasource_pool_member m ON m.pool_id = p.id INNER JOIN sys_datasource_config ds ON ds.id = m.datasource_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT execute_datasource_id, COUNT(1) AS running_count FROM t_quartz_task_status WHERE status = 2 AND execute_datasource_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY execute_datasource_id ) r ON r.execute_datasource_id = m.datasource_id WHERE p.id = #{poolId} AND p.status = 1 AND m.enabled = 1 AND COALESCE(ds.status, 1) = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.id
